page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. Catchword at the lower right and gathering signature at the lower centre. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Parisiis aperte declaravit: Verum de his infra.

JAM Polyglottorum Parisiensium primum volumen editum fuerat, com-plectens Biblia Graeca, Latina, Chaldaea & Hebraea, quae antea Antverpiae excusa fuerant, novumque testamentum quadri-lingue sub prelo erat, cum Morinus & Gabriel Sionita Syrus è monte Libano parant editionem Pentateuchi Samaritanam, Syriacam & Arabicam; ille Samaritanos codices, hic verò Syriacos & Arabicos una cum Latina Interpretatio-ne: verùm dum nimis urget operis illius editionem Morinus, minus accurati pro-dierunt Samaritani codices. Pentateuchum siquidem Hebraeo-Samaritanum ex uno exemplari Oratoriano, & versionem Samaritanam ex eo tantum, quod à Petro Valle acceperat, edidit; vix autem peracta fuerat illa editio, cum illi super-venerunt à Perescio, viro Clarissimo, gen-tis Samaritanae codices Hebraeo-Samaritani & Arabici; Thomas quoque Com-berus collegii Sanctae Trinitatis apud

page.notes: Faint marks along the left edge are show-through or the neighbouring page and are omitted. The accent over the u in "Verùm" and "verùm" is read as a grave accent; it is slightly blurred on the scan. The superscript a after "infra" is printed as a raised letter and is rendered as plain "infra".
